_comment: Weapons (docs/COMBAT.md). Order = the number keys: the first entry is weapon 1, the second weapon 2. kind: projectile | beam. damage per bolt; speed m/s relative to the shooter (bolts inherit the ship's velocity on top); lifetime seconds; range = beam length; rate_of_fire shots per second; heat_per_shot / heat_per_second add heat 0..1; cooldown_rate heat lost per second; overheat_lockout_seconds = cannot fire this long after overheating; recoil = m/s of ship speed per shot; spread = cone half angle in degrees; muzzle = [right, up, forward] offset in the ship frame; colour [r,g,b]; beam_dps damage per second on asteroids. Missing fields keep the built-in value.
